title: Canonical tensor action on the degree-n ideal summand
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion, $L$ invertible and $J^2=0$. Fix $n,e\ge0$, a TensorGradedPresentation $T$, and comparison data $D$ equal to canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation, lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Put $F=j^*(J\otimes L^n)$ and let $x:\mathcal O_Z\to ((j^*L)^n)^{e+1}$. Suppose $\sigma$ and $\mu$ obey the local lift and global section action equations of [lem-sc-tensor-graded-quotient-action-homogeneous]. Then $k_n;\mu(\mathrm{tensorGradedSection}(T,D,e,x))=\mathrm{tensorBoundaryKernelMap}_{n,0,e+1}(\mathrm{id}_F\otimes x);k_{n(e+2)}$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection, lem-sc-tensor-boundary-kernel-map-naturality]. This concerns only the degree-n summand and no projection.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and its graded direct sum; Tag 0B8S, cohomology-lemma-boundary-derivation-over-cup-product, first proof paragraph.

proof.text: Substitute D and use the epi unit in degree n(e+1) to choose local lifts t of the canonically transported x(1).

The local kernel-map multiplication formula gives the inclusion of the transported map as tensorPowAddIso applied to t tensor kernel.ι(y). Apply k_inclusion to the output. An equality cast along n(e+1)+n=n(e+2) commutes with the family b by equality elimination.

Compute i of the action with hglobal, hlocal, b_quotient, k_inclusion and b_multiply. The preceding formula is exactly that product. Cancel the mono i. Naturality and sheaf separation glue the local equality of morphisms.
